title: Por(n)tals 0.4
author: onehend
font_credit: Noto Sans SC (c) 2022 The Noto Project Authors (https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk)
_shim_merged: The patch shipped as two files, zz_zh_setup.rpy and zz_zh_names.rpy. games.patch_entries() reads one `shim` from game.json and package_release.py writes that one file, so the pair was concatenated into patch/zz_zh_locale.rpy. Straight concatenation is order-safe: both files used `init 999 python:`, which Ren'Py allows more than once and runs in file order, and every other priority is distinct (-4000 setup, -300 names, -100 setup).
_font_path_note: The tested patch referenced the bundled face as `Fonts/NotoSansSC-VF.ttf`. tools/install.py and tools/package_release.py can only write game/fonts/, and adding a game must not change tools/, so the shim now says `fonts/NotoSansSC-VF.ttf`. Same file one directory up in case; Ren'Py resolves both against game/.
_distribution_boot_bug: This distribution does not boot as shipped, with or without this patch: renpy/common/00layout.rpy:124 calls renpy.has_screen(), and in this build `renpy` resolves to the renpy PACKAGE rather than renpy.exports, so the call raises AttributeError. Section 0 of zz_zh_locale.rpy copies every missing export onto the package and then overrides the three names where a submodule shadows an exported function. That block is a fix for the distribution, not for localisation -- delete it if the engine is ever swapped for a stock Ren'Py 8.2.
_name_mapping: Ren'Py does not route Character("Mom") through the translation system, so names are remapped instead: every ADVCharacter is rewritten as it is constructed at init -300, and anything already in the store is swept afterwards. Names that are expressions ("[mc_name]", the player's own name) are deliberately absent so they keep evaluating.
_do_not_run_build_tl: patch/tl/schinese/ is the shipped patch, not the output of tools/build_tl.py. 1,790 English source lines here legitimately translate two ways depending on context -- 'What?' is 什么？ answering a non-question and 怎么了？ answering a repetition. data/tl_trans.json is a flat dictionary keyed on the English source, so it holds only one form per key. Measured: rebuilding changes the text of 2,397 patch lines and no line differs by spacing alone. Edit patch/tl/schinese/ directly and re-run python tools/check.py --game portals-04.
